about: A person's verdict on each finding of `npm run validate`, recorded by `npm run review` (or by hand). "ok": the sources disagree but the site is right, keep it quiet. "error": the site is wrong, keep failing until the data is fixed. A verdict holds for the exact message it was given on; when the finding changes it is asked again.
